papers.title: Gastrodin inhibits osteoclastogenesis via down-regulating the NFATc1 signaling pathway and stimulates osseointegration in vitro.
papers.abstract: Bone is a rigid yet dynamic organ, and this dynamism is mediated by the delicate balance between osteoclastic bone resorption and osteoblastic bone formation. However, excessive activation of osteoclasts is responsible for many bone diseases such as osteoporosis, Paget disease, and tumor bone metastasis. Agents that could inhibit osteoclast formation or function are regarded as promising alternatives to treat osteoclast-related diseases. Recently, traditional Chinese medicine has attracted attention because of its multiple activities in bone metabolism. Among them, gastrodin has been reported as an anti-osteoporosis agent that reduces reactive oxygen species. However, the direct action of gastrodin on osteoclast differentiation and bone resorption, and its underlying molecular mechanism, remain unknown. In this study, we investigated the effects of gastrodin on receptor activator NF-κB ligand (RANKL)-activated osteoclasts formation and bone resorption. Our results showed that gastrodin retarded RANKL-induced osteoclast differentiation efficiently by downregulating transcriptional and translational expression of nuclear factor of activated T cells cl (NFATc1), a major factor in RANKL-mediated osteoclastogenesis. Meanwhile, gastrodin prevented osteoclast maturation and migration by inhibiting the gene expression of dendrocyte expressed seven transmembrane protein (DC-STAMP), an osteoclastic-specific gene that controls cells fusion and movement. And gastrodin prevented RANKL-induced osteoclastic bone erosion in vitro. In addition, gastrodin also stimulated bone mesenchymal stem cell (BMSC) spreading and osseointegration in titanium plate. In summary, gastrodin could prevent osteoclasts formation and bone resorption via blockage of NFATc1 activity, and stimulate osseointegration in vitro. Gastrodin could be developed as a potent phytochemical candidate to treat osteolytic diseases.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究天麻素对破骨细胞和骨整合的生化作用，未涉及增材制造或力学测试。
llm.why_not_core: No additive manufacturing, porous structures, mechanical testing, fatigue, or LPBF fabrication; purely biochemical in vitro study.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究天麻素对破骨细胞分化和骨整合的作用机制
summary_zh.method: 体外细胞实验，检测RANKL诱导的破骨细胞分化和NFATc1信号
summary_zh.result: 天麻素通过下调NFATc1抑制破骨细胞形成，并促进BMSC在钛板上的整合
summary_zh.validation: 体外细胞培养和荧光染色

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the direct effects of gastrodin on osteoclast differentiation and bone resorption, and its potential to promote osseointegration.
summary_en.method: In vitro assays using bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells (BMSCs) and osteoclast precursors with RANKL stimulation, evaluating gene and protein expression.
summary_en.result: Gastrodin suppresses osteoclastogenesis via NFATc1 downregulation and enhances BMSC spreading on titanium surfaces.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell culture experiments with tartrate-resistant acid phosphatase (TRAP) staining and bone resorption pit assays.

papers.title: Characterisation of a novel Sc and Zr modified Al–Mg alloy fabricated by selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Materials Science and Engineering, Monash University, Clayton, VIC 3800, Australia

corresponding_authors.name: Paul Rometsch
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Materials Science and Engineering, Monash University, Clayton, VIC 3800, Australia

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是Sc和Zr改性Al-Mg合金的选区激光熔化制备，与生物医学植入物或应力屏蔽无关。
llm.why_not_core: No porous structure, no stress shielding analysis, no fatigue testing, no surface roughness or osseointegration, and no biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究Sc和Zr改性对选区激光熔化Al-Mg合金显微组织和力学性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 通过选区激光熔化制备不同成分的Al-Mg-Sc-Zr合金，并进行表征。
summary_zh.result: 添加Sc和Zr显著细化晶粒并提高强度，获得高致密度和良好力学性能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过SEM、EDS、拉伸测试等实验手段验证显微组织和力学性能。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of Sc and Zr modification on the microstructure and mechanical properties of Al-Mg alloy fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Al-Mg alloys with varying Sc and Zr contents were fabricated by selective laser melting and characterized for microstructure and mechanical properties.
summary_en.result: The addition of Sc and Zr significantly refined grains and enhanced strength, achieving high densification and good mechanical performance.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed via SEM, EDS, and tensile testing to confirm microstructural and mechanical improvements.
